title: Spicy Thai Chicken Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with spicy Thai red curry paste, chicken, and noodles.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the sliced onions and bell peppers to the skillet and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chicken broth to the skillet and bring to a simmer.
Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the noodles to the skillet and cook until they are well coated with the sauce and heated through.
Season the stir fry with fish sauce and sugar to taste.
Serve the stir fry hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
